BrochureContent.Content:
A beautifully positioned three bedroom, three bathroom dormer bungalow set against truly sensational countryside and mountain views, with the added charm of a peaceful riverside setting just minutes from Ardara. 

This home offers space, privacy, and a stunning natural backdrop that buyers will instantly connect with.

The dormer layout provides generous room sizes throughout, including three well appointed bathrooms, comfortable living areas. Large windows frame the sweeping landscape, bringing light and scenery into every corner of the home. The bedrooms are spacious, with excellent potential for family living, guest accommodation, or a luxurious main suite.

Outside, the property enjoys an idyllic rural atmosphere, rolling hills, mountain silhouettes, and the gentle flow of the nearby river create a setting that feels both tranquil and inspiring. 

Whether you`re gardening, entertaining, or simply relaxing, the views make every moment special.
